data.action: 躺椅上拉低墨镜打量你，湿发铺开星瞳狡黠
data.camera: medium shot, lounging with sunglasses, pool glow, teasing mood
data.description: 【学园都市室内泳池·夏日】白金比基尼的女王蜂斜倚在池畔躺椅上，金色长发湿漉漉地铺开，雪白手套难得换成了裸手。她把王冠造型的墨镜往下一拉，星瞳越过镜框上缘打量你——「盯着我看的话，要收观光费哦♪ 现金……或者陪本小姐游十圈也可以。」
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki rests on the poolside deck chair in her white-and-gold two-piece and light sarong, wet blonde hair spread over the towel. She lowers her crown-shaped sunglasses with a bare hand and looks over them with a playful star-pupiled glance. The medium view includes chair and pool rim receding behind. Refracted water light moves across the towel and glasses, illuminating her face against the softer shade beneath the chair's frame.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 泳池畔的王冠保养·「盯着我看的话，要收观光费哦」
